tbesh_html:
1) to tie, bind, bind on, bind up, saddle, restrain, bandage, govern
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to bind, bind on
1a2) to bind up
1b) (Piel) to bind, restrain
1c) (Pual) to be bound up

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to wrap firmly (especially a turban, compress, or saddle); figuratively, to stop, to rule
strongs_1890.kjv_def: bind (up), gird about, govern, healer, put, saddle, wrap about.
